_help: claude-kit per-repo config, schema v2. `npx claude-kit init` generates this from detection; edit freely afterwards — `npx claude-kit doctor` validates it against the repo. Consumed by: guard-bash.mjs (guard), lint-format-fix.mjs (fix + targets), changeset-check.mjs (changesets + targets), package-changelog.mjs (targets, when ledger.enabled).

custom.message: Example custom rule — delete or replace.

_notes.targets[].fixCommands: optional per-target override of fix.commands — real repos diverge (root `fix` vs package `lint:fix`).
_notes.targets[].changelogPath / logPath: only used when ledger.enabled; default to .claude/changelogs/<name>.md|.log so they never collide with changesets' CHANGELOG.md.
_notes.singlePackage: for a non-monorepo use one target with pathPrefix "" and sourcePath "src", plus fix.filterFlag "".
